attachments.insertion_landmark: medial border of scapula, below the spine

actions: retracts and downwardly rotates the scapula

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Deep to trapezius, running parallel to and just below rhomboid minor; the two rhomboids act as a functional unit despite being separately named.
functional_compartments.source: Holzbaur KR, Murray WM, Delp SL (2005) Ann Biomed Eng 33(6):829-840 -- upper-extremity muscle architecture model (fascicle length, pennation, PCSA)

motor_endplate_zones.method: modified Sihler staining, whole-mount nerve arborization mapping
motor_endplate_zones.notes: Unlike rhomboid minor, the densest arborization for rhomboid major sits in the MIDDLE third, not split around it -- the two muscles are not mirror images in this respect. The dorsal scapular nerve's entry point for both muscles is in the middle third at the C7-T1 level specifically, one row above rhomboid major's own span, so this zone does not carry the same nerve-trunk risk rhomboid minor's middle third does.
motor_endplate_zones.source: Yi KH, Lee HJ, Choi YJ, Hu KS, Kim HJ, 'Intramuscular Neural Distribution of Rhomboid Muscles: Evaluation for Botulinum Toxin Injection Using Modified Sihler's Method', Toxins 12(5):289 (2020), doi:10.3390/toxins12050289 -- 30 rhomboid major + 30 minor muscles, 10 of each Sihler-stained, Korean cadavers. Retrieved via PubMed (PMC7291336).

source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998); Holzbaur KR, Murray WM, Delp SL (2005) Ann Biomed Eng 33(6):829-840 -- upper-extremity muscle architecture model (fascicle length, pennation, PCSA)

trigger_points.location_description: Trigger points along the medial scapular border, palpated with the scapula protracted (hand across chest)
trigger_points.referred_pain_pattern: Superficial aching pain along the medial border of the scapula and the interscapular zone -- present at rest, unchanged by ordinary movement, often with snapping/crunching on scapular motion. Does not project to the arm.
trigger_points.activation_perpetuating_factors: Ache with prolonged sitting/rounded posture rather than true motion loss; fatigue holding retraction.
trigger_points.notes: This atlas's source document covers rhomboid major and minor together as a single 'Rhomboid major & minor' section without differentiating trigger points between the two muscles.
trigger_points.source: Simons, Travell & Simons Trigger Point Manual -- as cited in this atlas's uploaded shoulder muscle reference document (Donnelly JM, Fernandez-de-las-Penas C, Finnegan M, Freeman JL (eds), Myofascial Pain and Dysfunction: The Trigger Point Manual, 3rd ed., Wolters Kluwer, 2019)
